items.description:
If you'd like to add an awesome list to that's related to Node.js, be sure to read the contribution guidelines and then make your change and open a pull request!
Be sure to check out the official Node.js website and the Node.js GitHub organization if you'd like to get involved. Find the original article that sparked this list on the NodeSource Blog.
Like ? Reach out to @bitandbang on Twitter to say hi! 👋
